acceptanceCriteria: Failing tests are named from a reproduced loaded run.
Fixtures use condition or event waits, or deadlines scaled without weakening what is asserted.
The tests pass 20 consecutive runs under a saturating load.
body:
Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, origin/main 8a3e3a5b. The PSR (pool sweep, PSR-V0-*) store tests in internal/tasks/store flaked on a heavily loaded host and passed when run alone. Item 11 (#498 store tests sensitive to host load: PSR reconcile/dispatch tests in internal/tasks/store) appears to be the same family and is merged here; confirm when diagnosing. Suspected, not confirmed: timing-based waits or fixed deadlines in the fixtures. Related prior load-flake tickets: V1-0395, V1-0455, V1-0636. Reproduce: run go test -count=1 ./internal/tasks/store/ concurrently with a CPU-saturating load, then rerun alone. Expected: deterministic under load (event/condition waits, not wall-clock). Actual: intermittent failures under load, pass alone. The failing test names were not retained.

Additional evidence 2026-10-04: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, origin/main b46a3e27, corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202. `GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 -run TestPSR ./internal/tasks/store/` was run three times while three concurrent agents were running Go test suites on the same host. With TMPDIR resolved to the non-symlinked /private/var/folders/zc/wb4tdm4x0c9dpkmkn8rdg9rw0000gn/T/, it failed only TestPSRDeadlineRetryMatrix/retry-success (8.08s; pool_sweep_lifecycle_test.go:326: commands reset=2 verify=0; package 172.4s). With TMPDIR=/private/tmp/claude-501/td, run straight afterwards, all PSR tests passed (138.5s). With the default symlinked TMPDIR, there were 49 UNSUPPORTED_FILESYSTEM failures, which are V1-0753, not this ticket. Inference, not confirmed: the deadline-retry matrix belongs to this load-sensitive family, and the long resolved path played no part, because V1-0723's identifier error did not appear.

Additional evidence 2026-10-05: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, batch branch 4390ee3e (PR #570). The TestPSR* tests in internal/tasks/store timed out while running concurrently with other packages and go vet. Rerun alone they passed (85s), and the whole package passed (353s). This names the failing family as TestPSR*; individual subtest names were not retained.
title: PSR pool-sweep and reconcile/dispatch store tests are sensitive to host load (merges item 11, #498)
